_note: Hand-written merchandising layered over the ledger by build-catalogue.mjs, keyed by slug. In the Google Sheet these become the Tagline / Description / Specs / Featured columns. Specs are DRAFT from public spec sheets and must be confirmed by the client before launch.

zhiyun-weebill-3.tagline: The mirrorless workhorse, with light and sound built in.
zhiyun-weebill-3.description: Weebill 3 carries a full mirrorless rig all day on one hand. The sling grip and wrist rest take the weight off your forearm, the built-in fill light and microphone mean fewer things to bolt on, and the app handles balancing, tracking and timelapse.

feiyutech-scorp-c2.tagline: Serious stabilisation without the serious price.
feiyutech-scorp-c2.description: The SCORP-C2 gives a mirrorless or light cinema body three-axis stabilisation, a real handle you can hold underslung, and enough battery for a full shoot day. It is the gimbal we recommend first to anyone stepping up from a phone.

colbor-cl60-cob-light.tagline: Sixty five watts of daylight from a light that fits in a bag.
colbor-cl60-cob-light.description: The CL60 is the small COB light that keeps ending up on every shoot: bi-colour, accurate skin tones, Bowens-adaptable, and it runs off a laptop charger or an NP-F battery. Pair it with a 65 cm softbox and you have a key light for interviews and product work.
specs: Colbor mini mount, Bowens adapter included

hollyland-lark-m2-combo.tagline: Two nine-gram microphones and nowhere to clip a cable.
hollyland-lark-m2-combo.description: Lark M2 is the wireless kit that disappears on camera. Each transmitter weighs nine grams and clips or magnets to a shirt, and the combo ships with both a camera receiver and a phone receiver, so one kit covers interviews, vlogs and phone-first content.
specs: up to 300 m line of sight

dji-mic-mini-2-combo.tagline: DJI's smallest wireless mic, in the full two-person kit.
dji-mic-mini-2-combo.description: Two transmitters, one receiver and a charging case: the Mic Mini combo is the set-and-forget audio kit for creators who shoot with a phone or a mirrorless body. Pairs directly with DJI cameras and phones, and the case keeps everything topped up between shoots.
specs: up to 48 h with the case

viltrox-dc-550-monitor.tagline: A bright 5.5-inch field monitor that survives daylight.
viltrox-dc-550-monitor.description: The DC-550 puts a full-HD touch monitor on top of your rig with 3D LUTs, waveform, false colour and peaking, so what you see is what you shot. It mounts on any cold shoe and runs from an NP-F battery.

zhiyun-crane-m3.tagline: One gimbal for the phone, the action cam and the mirrorless.
zhiyun-crane-m3.description: Crane M3 is the compact all-rounder: light enough to carry all day, strong enough for a mirrorless body with a small prime, and it balances a phone or an action camera with the included mounts. The built-in fill light saves a trip back to the bag.

godox-s65t-softbox.tagline: A 65 cm octabox that opens like an umbrella.
godox-s65t-softbox.description: The S65T sets up in seconds, folds down to the size of an umbrella and turns any Bowens light into a soft, flattering key. It ships with the inner and outer diffusers and a grid for controlling spill.
specs: Inner and outer diffusion, honeycomb grid

feelworld-f6-plus-v2-monitor-kit.tagline: Six inches of touch monitoring, with the battery and arm in the box.
feelworld-f6-plus-v2-monitor-kit.description: The F6 Plus V2 kit is the field monitor as a complete package: screen, tilt arm, sun hood and battery. Load your LUTs, expose with waveform and false colour, and stop guessing from the camera's own display.
specs: Monitor, tilt arm, sun hood, NP-F battery

zhiyun-smooth-5.tagline: The phone gimbal for people who film with a phone on purpose.
zhiyun-smooth-5.description: Smooth 5 holds the latest large phones with a case on, adds a fill light with magnetic filters, and has real controls: a focus wheel, a joystick and a mode switch you can work without looking. Runs a full day.
specs: Phones up to 300 g with case

sony-fx30-cinema-camera.tagline: Sony's entry into Cinema Line, still in the box.
sony-fx30-cinema-camera.description: The FX30 is the compact cinema camera built around the same colour science as the FX3 and FX6: dual base ISO, S-Cinetone, 4K up to 120 fps and a body that mounts straight into a cage with 1/4-20 threads on every side.

dji-rs4-mini-combo.tagline: DJI's compact gimbal with tracking in the combo kit.
dji-rs4-mini-combo.description: The RS 4 Mini carries a mirrorless body with a mid-size zoom, balances in minutes with the Teflon-coated arms, and the combo adds the tracking module, the briefcase handle and the phone holder. Vertical shooting is a quick flip, not a rebuild.

feiyutech-scorp-mini-2-kit.tagline: One stabiliser for every camera you own.
feiyutech-scorp-mini-2-kit.description: SCORP-Mini 2 swaps between a phone, an action camera and a light mirrorless body with the clamps in the kit. AI tracking follows a face without an app, and the touch screen keeps the phone free for framing.

magic-arm-super-clamp-kit.tagline: The two pieces that put a monitor, light or mic anywhere.
magic-arm-super-clamp-kit.description: An 11-inch articulated arm with a super clamp on the end. Clamp it to a light stand, a desk or a cage and lock the arm with one lever. Every rig ends up needing two.

canon-ef-to-rf-adapter.tagline: Keep every EF lens you own on a mirrorless body.
canon-ef-to-rf-adapter.description: The EF to RF mount adapter carries autofocus, stabilisation and aperture control from EF and EF-S glass to any EOS R body, with no loss of image quality. Weather-sealed and tripod-collar ready.

rgb-led-tube-light-30cm.tagline: A pocket tube of colour for backgrounds and rims.
rgb-led-tube-light-30cm.description: A 30 cm RGB tube light with a built-in battery and magnets on the back. Dial in any colour or a white balance from tungsten to daylight, stick it to anything metal, and paint a background or rim a subject in seconds.
specs: Full RGB plus 2,500 K to 9,000 K white
up to 3 h at full power
